inntektsinformasjon.infoOmFørstegangstje: Information for Those in Military Service
If you are in military or civil service and wish to apply for maternity benefits, you must unfortunately apply on paper.
You fill out the paper application for maternity benefits and send it by mail along with the form from the Labor Inspection Authority.
inntektsinformasjon.alert.ingenArbeidsfo: You cannot apply for pregnancy benefits since you have no employment.
As there is no registered employment for you, or any information indicating that you are a freelancer or self-employed, you are unfortunately not eligible to apply for maternity benefits.
ArbeidsforholdOgInntektPanel.Definisjone: How are different types of employment and income defined?

You are considered self-employed when you have a sole proprietorship with taxable activity. A hobby, on the other hand, is tax-free and is not counted as income. See the Tax Administration's guide if you are unsure.
A freelancer is someone who receives a fee, salary or other remuneration for work or assignments without being employed. See the Tax Administration's guide if you are unsure.
Are you a fisher or crew member on a boat?
If you are a fisher paid by share or own your boat, the employment relationship must be registered as self-employment.
If you are a fisher or crew member receiving wages, your employer must register your income in the Employer and Employee Register.
Have you had other pensionable income?

Military service, severance pay, severance packages and income from abroad may also affect your parental benefit and are subject to separate rules. You can add this yourself if it is not shown in the overview.

LeggTilAndreInntekterWizard.savnerInntek: Are you missing an income source in the overview?
If you notice errors or missing information, you must ask your employer to register the correct information in the Register of Employers and Employees. We retrieve the information from there.
LeggTilAndreInntekterWizard.fiskerForm.l: Income as a fisher or crew member
LeggTilAndreInntekterWizard.fiskerForm.i: We need correct information about your work situation to calculate your parental benefit. Your information will also be sent to the Norwegian Tax Administration.
LeggTilAndreInntekterWizard.fiskerForm.l: What arrangement do you have as a fisher or crew member?
LeggTilAndreInntekterWizard.lott.label: Income from lott
LeggTilAndreInntekterWizard.lott.content: Lott is considered business income because you receive a share of the catch value rather than a fixed wage. Therefore, the income is treated as self-employment income, and we need information about your business.
LeggTilAndreInntekterWizard.hyre.title: You must ask your employer to register you as an employee
LeggTilAndreInntekterWizard.hyre.content: You are considered an employee when you, as a fisher or crew member, receive hire (wages). If your employment relationship is not shown in the overview, it means your employer has not reported it to the Register of Employers and Employees. This is not required by law, but it must be done for you to be able to receive parental benefit. Your employer must also submit an income statement before you can be paid parental benefit.
LeggTilAndreInntekterWizard.lottOgHyre.t: You are both self-employed and an employee
LeggTilAndreInntekterWizard.lottOgHyre.c: Lott is considered business income because you receive a share of the catch value rather than a fixed wage. Therefore, you are considered self-employed, and we need information about your business. You are considered an employee when you, as a fisher or crew member, receive hire (wages). If your employment relationship is not shown in the overview, it means your employer has not reported it to the Register of Employers and Employees. This is not required by law, but it must be done for you to be able to receive parental benefit.
LeggTilAndreInntekterWizard.egenBåt.cont: If you are a fisher with your own boat, you are self-employed. The questions you are asked in the application are adapted to your situation, and you will receive guidance and information along the way.
